title: 第12章 传染的灯笼第13章 尸陀鬼之手
lines: 血液涂满整个屏幕。
一只遍布红血丝的眼睛从屏幕上长了出来！
眼珠死死盯住苏午，‘黄至诚’的声音从手机扬声器里传出：“我看到你了！”
“我看到你了！”
苏午心里一个激灵，直接把手机丢出老远。
手机撞在砖墙上，落在墙角，溅起了一团灰尘。
屏幕仍然亮着光，但蒙在屏幕上的血迹却倏忽消失，没有了痕迹。
手掌撑着地面，苏午从地上爬起，走到墙角去看自己那台手机。
除却边角有磕碰的痕迹，手机并未损坏，屏幕上还显示着群聊天的界面，‘工作群’里的最后一条群聊天记录是‘黄至诚’发出的：“我看到你了！”
“就这？”
他皱着眉头，又把手机捡起来，点进工作群个人设置界面，直接退出了群。
拿着手机在小庙里安静等了几分钟。
手机没有异常。
自己也未被再度拉进工作群内。
“看来这种诡异是通过‘黄至诚’的社交账号，或者是那个工作群来传播的，跟手机本身应该没有关系。
不过，‘黄至诚’刚才说看到我了，那它会将我当做目标吗？
如果抓到我，还能把我拖回去继续加班不成？
以及，‘黄至诚’只是在群里放了狠话，却没有当场出来把我带走，是不是因为小庙本身规避或者阻挡了它对我的抓捕？”
想到这里，苏午内心有些怒气。
都已经到了这种地步，该死的东西还想压榨自己！
‘咕噜噜噜……’
苏午的腹部传出一阵响声。
他摸了摸肚子，感觉到饥饿感正在迅速增加。
刚才翻阅各种信息的时候，他就已经感觉到肚子有点饿了，没想到才过去短短十几分钟，他就有点无法忍受这种饥饿感。
未来的自己没有吃晚饭吗？
饿得也太快了。
不过这也给自己提了个醒，要提前准备一些生活必需品，在这个小庙附近找个地方寄存。
到自己真正开始在现实里逃生的时候，就可以省很多事。
而且减少外出频率，可以有效降低灯笼诡杀死自己的概率。
苏午把手机留在了小庙里，拖着右腋下的鬼手，走出了小庙。
此时漫天红灯笼刚刚消失，正是街道霓虹闪烁的时候。
一出小庙，他直接锁定数十米外的一个小副食店，迈动步子奔了过去。
饥饿感像一团火在他肚子里灼烧着。
content_en:
Blood smeared across the screen.
A red bloodshot eye grew out of the screen!
Eyes fixed on Su Wu, the voice of 'Huang Zhicheng' came from the speaker of the mobile phone: "I see you!"
"I see you!"
Su Wu felt excited and threw the phone away.
The phone hit the brick wall and landed in the corner, sending up a cloud of dust.
The screen was still bright, but the blood stains on the screen suddenly disappeared without a trace.
With his palms on the ground, Su Wu got up from the ground and walked to the corner to look at his mobile phone.
Except for scratches on the corners, the phone was not damaged, and the group chat interface was still displayed on the screen. The last group chat record in the ‘work group’ was from ‘Huang Zhicheng’: “I saw you!”
"That's it?"
He frowned, picked up his phone again, clicked into the personal settings interface of the work group, and exited the group directly.
I waited quietly in the small temple for a few minutes with my cell phone in hand.
There is nothing wrong with the phone.
I have not been drawn into the work group again.
“It seems that this weirdness was spread through ‘Huang Zhicheng’s’ social account or the work group, and it should have nothing to do with the mobile phone itself.
However, 'Huang Zhicheng' just said it saw me, will it regard me as its target?
If you catch me, can you drag me back and continue working overtime?
Also, 'Huang Zhicheng' only said harsh words in the group, but did not come out to take me away on the spot. Is it because the small temple itself evaded or blocked its arrest of me? "
Thinking of this, Su Wu felt a little angry inside.
It's already reached this point, and the damn thing still wants to squeeze me!
'Guluuluulu...'
There was a sound in Su Wu's abdomen.
He touched his belly and felt his hunger growing rapidly.
When he was flipping through various information just now, he already felt a little hungry. Unexpectedly, only ten minutes had passed, and he couldn't stand the hunger.
Did your future self not have dinner?
I got hungry too quickly.
But this also reminds me to prepare some daily necessities in advance and find a place to store them near this small temple.
When you really start to escape from reality, you can save a lot of things.
Moreover, reducing the frequency of going out can effectively reduce the probability of the lantern trick killing you.
Su Wu left her cell phone in the small temple, dragged the ghost hand under her right armpit, and walked out of the small temple.
At this time, the red lanterns in the sky had just disappeared, and it was time for the streets to glow with neon lights.
As soon as he left the small temple, he directly targeted a small grocery store dozens of meters away and ran towards it.
Hunger burned like a fire in his belly.
title_en: Chapter 12 The Lantern of Infection Chapter 13 The Hand of the Corpse Ghost
